comingLast.roast: 4 holes of runway left - 2 points clears the fence
1 above the cellar door with 4 to play - just keep scoring
the gap is 2 - close enough that his mates ordered him a blue drink as a joke
3 above Bradley - the kind of lead that keeps a man honest
4 clear - his supporters (his group) keep reminding him loudly
the buffer reads 6 - his group reads it aloud each tee
